experience: Asked to use a 2.3 MB wallpaper as T3 Code's background, an agent could only embed it as data: text in theme CSS, hit the 20,000 character limit, and told the user T3 Code could not do it.

pattern: enable a built-in UI style without changing colors
experience: Asked to turn on Liquid Glass in T3 Code without changing the current color palette, an agent sets `styleId` via `t3_theme_set` rather than publishing a duplicate palette or editing source files.
rule: t3_theme_set: `styleId` selects a built-in or published UI style without changing the palette.

source.note: Extended user themes v2 separates palettes from composable styles.

t3_theme_read.guide: Use `t3_theme_set` with `themeId` for palettes and `styleId` for styles (`null` clears the style).

pattern: move a control somewhere else in T3 Code
experience: Asked to take the model and permission controls out of T3 Code's composer box and put them in a row under it, an agent picks the layout variant in a style with t3_theme_set instead of trying to move them with CSS.
rule: THEME_GUIDE: Layout (v2): optional `layout` picks a variant per region.

source.note: The Calm redesign moved the composer's controls below the box; themes gained layout regions so an agent can make that change without a T3 Code PR.

t3_theme_read.guide:
Themes restyle T3 Code on web and desktop. Mobile does not use them.
Layout (v2): optional `layout` picks a variant per region. The first variant is the stock layout. A value is a literal or `{ "setting": "<key>" }` naming a `select` setting whose option ids are that region's variants, so users can switch it under Settings -> Appearance. An active style replaces the palette's choice per region. A non-stock variant sets `data-layout-<region>="<variant>"` on `:root` (region in kebab case) for CSS. Layout moves whole controls, so change one region at a time and ask the user.
- composerControls ("inside" | "below"): the model, context and permission controls sit inside the composer card or in a row below it, leaving the prompt and send button in the card.
- composerMeter ("none" | "ring"): a context-window ring left of the model chip.
- runContext ("strip" | "chip"): the machine, workspace and branch controls under the composer, or one chip whose popover holds them.
- workspaceActions ("details" | "header"): Run, changed files and Commit & push live in the thread details card, or in the chat header with the PR beside the title; Open in editor then also sits on the changed-files card.
- threadDetails ("card" | "rail"): thread details as the always-open card, or a narrow rail of agent icons whose sections open cards on hover.
- panelControls ("titlebar" | "corner"): the panel toggles in the title bar, or in bottom corner bubbles without floating the panels.
- sidebarSections ("shelves" | "tabs"): Working, Snoozed and Settled as collapsible sections, or bottom tabs for Idle, Working and Snoozed with Recently settled behind a footer button.
- sidebarSearch ("row" | "hidden"): the sidebar's search row, or hidden with its buttons moved beside the app name.
CSS: `css` applies after the app's styles (palette CSS first, style CSS second). Use `.dark` or `:root:not(.dark)` for one appearance.

prompt: In T3 Code, I want the composer box to hold only what I'm typing and the send button. Put the model, context and permission controls in a row under the box instead.

pattern: ordinary restyle: resize the chat header
experience: A size change is CSS. The agent must not reach for a layout variant when the user only wants the header taller.
rule: THEME_GUIDE: CSS: `css` applies after the app's styles.

source.note: The guide's own example request: make T3 Code's chat header taller.
